main_text.p: in iis, quæ ibi subjunguntur, DEUS futuram Ecclesiæ sub Messiæ conditionē describeret, ea addidit quæ doctissimorum Iudæorum consensu nunquam in regno Messiæ futura fue-rant: ut allegoricè ista accipienda doceret. Cuiusmodi illud capitis 47.12. Hinc & inde arbores esculenti fructus, quarum folia non decidunt, & quarum fructus non consumuntur: etenim in ipsa rerum natura nihil immutandum temporibus Messiæ tradunt Iudæorum antiquissimi. Inspiciatur Codicis Talmud. de Sabbatho folium 63. editionis Venetæ, ubi in Gemara cum de rerum qua-rundam immutatione agitur, è doctoribus magni nominis quidam Samuel dixisse fertur אין בין העולם הזה ליום המשיח אלא שיעבוד מלכיות בלבד, non est inter hoc seculum sive tempus & tempora Messiæ differentia ulla, nisi quod subjuganda sint regna. Similia habet Iudæorum ille Doctor præclarus Moses Maimonis filius sui operis magni cap. ult. יד אל יעלה על הלב שביימוה[?] המשיח יבטל דבר ממנהגו של עולם או יהיה שם חידוש במעשה בראשית אלא עולם במנהגו הולך וזה שנאמר בישעיה וגר זאב עם כבש ונמר עם גדי ירבץ משל וחידה, Nesubeat cogitatio animum, die-bus Messiæ quidpiam in mundi gubernatione cessa-turum, aut aliquid novi fore in operibus creationis; sed mundus eadem ratione gubernabitur: quod ve-ro in Esaia dicitur, cap. 11. verf. 6. Et commorabitur lupus cum agno & pardus hœdo accubabit, allegoria est & ænigma. Quocirca, quandoquidem,ut docent Judæi,

page.notes: Left strip is the edge of the facing page and is excluded. No page number is printed. Hebrew in the line beginning "gni" is copied from the scan; the word marked [?] is doubtful. The Hebrew line opening "אל יעלה" is copied as printed and should be checked against the source. "ijs" is read as "iis" (vowel i) and "Cujusmodi" as "Cuiusmodi" per the i/j rule. "DEVS" is read as "DEUS" per the u/v rule. Printed "Nesubeat" is kept as one word, as set in the line.
